line.name: Deadwood Fat Bottom Betty
line.description: One of the 4 core Deadwood 'Wild Bunch' blends, debuted 2013 per founder Vaughn Boyd. The Gordito size is a size extension (added October 2019), not a separate blend.
line.factory: Drew Estate - likely La Gran Fabrica Drew Estate, Esteli, Nicaragua, consistent with other Deadwood blends, but this specific attribution for Fat Bottom Betty is an inference, not independently confirmed for this SKU.
line.status: current as of its 2019 release; current (2026) availability not independently confirmed this session.
